mood: Luxury editorial meets industrial B2B credibility. Warm, grounded, authoritative, and textural.

headings.usage_rules: Large scale, tight tracking (tracking-tighter) for H1. Used for all main editorial titles.

body.usage_rules: Clean, highly legible for product descriptions and B2B data.

mono.usage_rules: Used for technical data, SKUs, RFQ form labels, and overlines. Small size, uppercase, wide tracking (tracking-[0.2em]).

logo.styling: Arabic glyph 'ق' prominently displayed next to 'stones' in Cormorant Garamond. Bilingual visual feel. Iconic and intentional.

spacing_and_layout.strategy: Generous Spacing Philosophy with Industrial Grid.
spacing_and_layout.bento_grid: MODE A: THE 'TETRIS' GRID for product features and process section. Asymmetrical and open.
spacing_and_layout.technical_grid: Use grid borders for the technical tables and product specifications (border-collapse, border-border/40).
spacing_and_layout.padding: Generous internal padding for cards (p-8 to p-12).

surfaces_and_micro_themes.cards: GRID BORDERS (The 'Technical' Look). Expose the skeleton. Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow. Hover: border color brightens to primary.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.header: Solid dark background (bg-[#0A0909]/90) with subtle bottom border, or Glassmorphism (bg-black/60, backdrop-blur-xl, border-white/10).
surfaces_and_micro_themes.texture: MANDATORY: SVG noise/grain overlay on the page body to give a tactile, editorial paper feel.

components.buttons: Square or very minimal radius (rounded-sm). High contrast. Primary buttons in #E07A5F, secondary buttons are outline.
components.forms: Shadcn based. Use raw, technical styling. Labels in uppercase mono font. Sharp inputs, no rounded corners.
components.tables: Shadcn Table. Used for product variants and certifications. Monospace data cells.
components.images: Hero images must have a gradient overlay or bg-black/40 so text is legible. No generic full-screen overlays.

images.description: Macro photography of raw Himalayan pink salt crystals, dramatic lighting, dark obsidian background.
images.usage: Hero section background with appropriate overlay to establish the luxury feel.

images.description: Abstract elegant background mixing charcoal dark grey stone texture and glowing veins of translucent pink salt.
images.usage: Use for the 'Process' or 'About' section backgrounds to add depth.

images.description: Clean industrial warehouse storing large pallets of pink salt bricks, dark cinematic lighting.
Large cargo ship being loaded at night.
images.usage: Use in 'Certifications' or 'Export Global Reach' sections to highlight global shipping.
Use as a product thumbnail for raw edible salt.
Use in About section origin story.

pages.Home: Hero with 'ق stones', introductory mission statement, grid of 3 main product categories, B2B credibility numbers.
pages.About: Origin story (Khewra Salt Mine, Pakistan heritage), editorial layout with generous text spacing.
pages.Products: Himalayan pink salt only (edible salt, lamps, bath salt, bricks/tiles, animal licks). Technical specs with each.
pages.Process/Quality: Mining → processing → export pipeline. Timeline or step-by-step layout.
pages.Certifications: Grid of HALAL, ISO, FDA (placeholders). High contrast, dark mode.
pages.B2B_RFQ: Multi-field form (company, country, product, quantity, packaging, port, message). Industrial form styling.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the dark theme. Use the specified warm terracotta/pink salt accents sparingly to draw attention.
Use Cormorant Garamond for main headings (H1, H2) with tight tracking. Use IBM Plex Mono for overlines, labels, and technical data.
Build a 'noise/grain' overlay div covering the app to give a luxury editorial print feel.
Use Shadcn UI for forms, tables, and dialogs. Customize them to remove standard border-radii (use rounded-sm or none) and apply the dark/mineral color palette.
Build a custom 'Grid Borders' layout for data-heavy sections like product specifications.
Implement the 'ق stones' logo visually with a distinctive serif or Arabic font for 'ق'.
Never use generic full-screen overlays on images; use gradient overlays to preserve image clarity.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements.
